summary: End-to-end verification of the new Super Admin Menu Configuration feature (backend /api/menu-config CRUD + frontend /menu-config UI + /user-manuals + sidebar role gating). Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. Frontend: super admin can open Menu Customization, sees 10 categories with 14 role checkboxes each + 40 move-to-category dropdowns + up/down arrows; Save and Reset both produce success toasts. Franchise Owner correctly sees Help & Resources -> User Manuals but NOT Menu Customization, and is blocked from /menu-config route. /user-manuals page renders all 4 role cards (Super Admin, Center Manager, Accountant, Franchise Owner) plus a 'Complete User Manual (All Roles)' row.
action_items: Minor docs nit (no code change required): the review request mentions item path '/social-media-planner', but the actual menu path used in menuDefaults.js and Dashboard.jsx is '/social-media'. Frontend testid is 'menu-item-/social-media' and override key would also be '/social-media'. Backend persists whatever key is sent so this is purely a documentation discrepancy.
Minor copy nit: review-request mentions a 'Complete Manual' card; actual label on the page is 'Complete User Manual (All Roles)'. Card is present and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: menu_config.py uses a global mutable 'db' / 'verify_token' module-level singleton wired in server.py — fine and matches the pattern used by other routers (sales, mis, billing, etc.).
Save endpoint correctly sanitizes invalid roles via _sanitize_roles() (verified by test_save_sanitizes_invalid_roles).
Auth gating on save/reset is correct: 403 for non-super-admin (verified for Franchise Owner). GET requires any valid token (verified 401 for invalid).
MongoDB document uses fixed _id='global' so there is exactly one override doc per environment — replace_one(upsert=True) used correctly.
Frontend Dashboard.jsx fetches /api/menu-config on mount + window focus + 60s polling — propagation behavior matches PRD.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_menu_config.py covers all 4 endpoints (GET, save, reset, valid-roles) with auth gating and persistence verification. Frontend playwright flow covered: SA login -> /menu-config UI (10 cats, 14 role checkboxes, 40 item-move dropdowns, save+reset toasts) and FO login -> /user-manuals page + sidebar gating + /menu-config 403/route-blocked. Note: the social media planner item path is '/social-media' (NOT '/social-media-planner' as noted in the original review request).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Feature is functional end-to-end.
